readme:
Pixel tweaks for Xposed, each behind its own switch. Switches apply live and updates hot reload. > [!NOTE] > Built and tested on Pixels. A tweak broken on your ROM? Report it from the app.
Screenshots
## Install 1. Get the APK from [Releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) or the [Xposed Modules Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/eu.hxreborn.pixelinjector/releases). 2. Enable it in your Xposed manager and scope the apps you want tweaked. 3. Reboot once. ## Tweaks ### System UI - **Warm Tiles**: raises the limit of 3 bound tiles in Quick Settings. Same hook as [qs-boundless-tiles](https://github.com/hxreborn/qs-boundless-tiles). - **PillShot**: draws the app name on screenshots. Revived from eXtreames/PillShot. - **Mute screenshot sound**: skips the screenshot shutter sound. - **Empty shade message**: replaces the empty shade's trophy and text with your own. Android 17 only. - **Always expand notifications**: opens notifications expanded. - **Pin ongoing notifications**: stops swiping away ongoing notifications like media and VPN. - **Charging details**: adds watts, volts, amps and temperature to the lock screen charging text. - **Now playing chip**: shows the playing track in a status bar chip, with your own font and colors. - **Download chip**: shows download progress in a status bar chip. Ported from [Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify)'s ongoing action chip. - **Fingerprint icon**: replaces the lock screen fingerprint icon with a custom ROM icon or your own image. - **Hide shortcut circles**: removes the circle behind the lock screen shortcuts while they're off. - **Heads-up duration**: sets how long heads-up notifications show. - **Double tap status bar to sleep**: double tap empty status bar space to sleep. - **Biometric Bypass**: confirms the biometric prompt after a face unlock. Same hook as [biometric-bypass](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-bypass). ### System Framework - **Force NEW_TASK**: adds NEW_TASK to activity starts that match your rules. - **Clipboard in background**: allows selected apps to read the clipboard in the background. - **Screen off animation**: replaces the screen-off fade with a CRT animation. Frame math from the [YRRPs Lineage CRT](https://github.com/YRRPs/android_frameworks_base/pull/5). ### Launcher - **Double tap to sleep**: double tap empty home screen space to sleep. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide gesture pill**: hides the navigation handle and shrinks the bottom inset. - **Hide search bar**: hides the hotseat search bar. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Hide app shortcuts**: a long press on an app shows only the system actions. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. - **Home menu entry**: adds PixelInjector to the home screen long press menu. Pixel Launcher and Launcher3. > [!WARNING] > Double tap to sleep needs root for your launcher. On KernelSU and APatch, grant it in the manager. ### Gboard - **AMOLED black keyboard**: makes the dark keyboard pure black. Same hook as [gboard-material-expressive-black](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black). ### Phone - **Remove feedback chip**: removes the Help us improve chip and its after-call notification. Same hook as [gdialer-dechip](https://github.com/hxreborn/gdialer-dechip). ### File picker - **Force sort by newest first**: opens folders newest first in the file picker. Same hook as [remember-my-sort](https://github.com/hxreborn/remember-my-sort). ### KDE Connect - **KDE Connect Quiet**: stops KDE Connect from holding the Wi-Fi multicast lock. ### GitHub - **GH FastPass**: closes the GitHub app's approved 2FA dialog right away. Same hook as [gh-fast-pass](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass). ### Firefox - **Material You colors**: uses your wallpaper colors in Iceraven and Firefox. Private browsing turns dark red. - **Material 3 loading indicator**: shows pull to refresh as the shape morphing Material 3 indicator. - **Menu style: Classic popup**: opens the three-dot menu as a popup instead of the bottom sheet. - **Betterfox**: applies [Betterfox](https://github.com/yokoffing/Betterfox) prefs per browser, each one switchable. ## Report a bug In the app, Settings, Report a bug. Reports are end-to-end encrypted and you follow replies in Your reports. Or open a [GitHub issue](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/issues/new/choose), or reach me at [hxreborn@duck.com](mailto:hxreborn@duck.com) or on [Telegram](https://t.me/hxreb0rn).
Full specs | Part | Detail | | --- | --- | | Scheme | [HPKE](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180) RFC 9180 base mode | | Key exchange | DHKEM [X25519](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7748) HKDF-SHA256 | | Cipher | [AES-256-GCM](https://csrc.nist.gov/pubs/sp/800/38/d/final) | | Encrypted | Message, module log, app versions, ROM code from phones that aren't Pixels | | Not encrypted | Phone model, build, framework. Bound to the ciphertext as [associated data](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9180#section-5.2) | | Developer key | `3d76ec6a` | | Reply key | X25519 per report, wrapped by [Android Keystore](https://developer.android.com/privacy-and-security/keystore) | | Server | `reports.hxreborn.eu` holds no private key | | Redacted log data | Emails, phone numbers, IP and MAC addresses, Wi-Fi names, device and advertising IDs, storage paths, URL and header tokens ([Redactor](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/blob/main/app/src/main/kotlin/eu/hxreborn/pixelinjector/support/Redactor.kt)) | | Retention | 90 days | | Update check | On by default in Settings. A plain request every 6 hours with no device data |
## Credits
Projects this builds on - [5ec1cff/MyInjector](https://github.com/5ec1cff/MyInjector) for the module structure, the hot reload flow and the NEW_TASK rule grammar. - [tehcneko/clipboardwhitelist](https://github.com/tehcneko/clipboardwhitelist) for the clipboard hook idea. - [Mahmud0808/PixelLauncherEnhanced](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/PixelLauncherEnhanced) for the gesture pill and search bar hooks. - [Mahmud0808/Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify) for the ongoing action chip behind the download chip. - [LuckyPray/DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) for the dex search library. - [JingMatrix/Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) for the module log screen design. - [Material Symbols](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) for the empty shade icons (Apache 2.0). - [Material Components for Android](https://github.com/material-components/material-components-android) for the loading indicator shapes and motion (Apache 2.0). - [BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches](https://github.com/BlazeFTL/FTL-Patches) for the classic popup menu. - AospExtended's UdfpsResources for the fingerprint icons, taken from [Syberia](https://github.com/syberia-project/platform_vendor_syberia), [DerpFest](https://github.com/DerpFest-AOSP/vendor_derp), [AfterlifeOS](https://github.com/AfterlifeOS/packages_overlays_Themes), [Infinity-X](https://github.com/ProjectInfinity-X/packages_overlays_Themes), [AlphaDroid](https://github.com/AlphaDroid-Project/vendor_addons), [crDroid](https://github.com/crdroidandroid/android_vendor_addons) and [AospExtended](https://github.com/AospExtended/platform_vendor_aosp).

<图片>

Xpose 的像素调整，每个都有自己的开关。交换机实时应用并更新热重载。 > [!注意] > 在 Pixel 上构建并测试。你的 ROM 上的调整被破坏了吗？从应用程序报告。 <详情> 屏幕截图 <表> ## 安装 1. 从 [Releases](https://github.com/hxreborn/PixelInjector/releases/latest) 或 [Xposed Modules Repo](https://github.com/Xposed-Modules-Repo/eu.hxreborn.pixelinjector/releases) 获取 APK。 2. 在您的 Xposed 管理器中启用它并范围您想要调整的应用程序。 3. 重新启动一次。 ## 调整 ### 系统界面 - **温暖瓷砖**：提高了快速设置中 3 个绑定瓷砖的限制。与 [qs-boundless-tiles](https://github.com/hxreborn/qs-boundless-tiles) 相同的钩子。 - **PillShot**：在屏幕截图上绘制应用程序名称。从 eXtreames/PillShot 中复活。 - **静音屏幕截图声音**：跳过屏幕截图快门声音。 - **空阴影消息**：将空阴影的奖杯和文本替换为您自己的。仅限安卓 17。 - **始终展开通知**：打开展开的通知。 - **固定持续通知**：停止清除媒体和 VPN 等持续通知。 - **充电详细信息**：在锁屏充电文本中添加瓦特、伏特、安培和温度。 - **正在播放芯片**：在状态栏芯片中显示播放曲目，并使用您自己的字体和颜色。 - **下载芯片**：在状态栏芯片中显示下载进度。移植自 [Iconify](https://github.com/Mahmud0808/Iconify) 的持续动作芯片。 - **指纹图标**：用自定义 ROM 图标或您自己的图像替换锁屏指纹图标。 - **隐藏快捷方式圆圈**：在锁定屏幕快捷方式关闭时删除它们后面的圆圈。 - **提醒持续时间**：设置提醒通知显示的时间长度。 - **双击状态栏进入睡眠**：双击empty 状态栏空间可供睡眠。 - **生物识别旁路**：在面部解锁后确认生物识别提示。与 [biometric-bypass](https://github.com/hxreborn/biometric-bypass) 相同的钩子。 ### 系统框架 - **强制 NEW_TASK**：将 NEW_TASK 添加到与您的规则匹配的活动开始。 - **后台剪贴板**：允许选定的应用程序在后台读取剪贴板。 - **屏幕关闭动画**：用 CRT 动画替换屏幕关闭淡入淡出。来自 [YRRPs Lineage CRT](https://github.com/YRRPs/android_frameworks_base/pull/5) 的帧数学。 ### 启动器 - **双击睡眠**：双击空白的主屏幕空间进入睡眠。像素启动器和启动器3。 - **隐藏手势药丸**：隐藏导航手柄并缩小底部插图。 - **隐藏搜索栏**：隐藏热座搜索栏。像素启动器和启动器3。 - **隐藏应用程序快捷方式**：长按应用程序仅显示系统操作。像素启动器和启动器3。 - **主菜单条目**：将 PixelInjector 添加到主屏幕长按菜单。像素启动器和启动器3。 > [!警告] > 双击睡眠需要启动器的 root 权限。在 KernelSU 和 APatch 上，在管理器中授予它。 ### Gboard - **AMOLED黑色键盘**：使深色键盘纯黑色。与 [gboard-material-expressive-black](https://github.com/hxreborn/gboard-material-expressive-black) 相同的钩子。 ### 电话 - **删除反馈芯片**：删除帮助我们改进芯片及其后呼叫通知。与 [gdialer-dechip](https://github.com/hxreborn/gdialer-dechip) 相同的钩子。 ### 文件选择器 - **强制按最新的优先排序**：在文件选择器中首先打开最新的文件夹。与 [remember-my-sort](https://github.com/hxreborn/remember-my-sort) 相同的钩子。 ### KDE 连接 - **KDE Connect Quiet**：阻止 KDE Connect 保持 Wi-Fi 多播锁定。 ### GitHub - **GH FastPass**：立即关闭 GitHub 应用程序批准的 2FA 对话框。与 [gh-fast-pass](https://github.com/hxreborn/gh-fast-pass) 相同的钩子。 ### 火狐 -
